segments.src: ## A Broader Squeeze on Tehran's Finances

segments.src: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent framed the action as part of a coordinated effort to close remaining gaps in the sanctions regime, specifically pointing to networks involved in digital-asset transfers, gold trading, shipping logistics, and aviation support.
segments.tr: 스콧 베센트 재무장관은 이번 조치가 제재 체제의 남은 허점을 메우기 위한 공동 노력의 일환이라고 설명하며, 특히 디지털 자산 이전, 금 거래, 해운 물류, 항공 지원에 관여한 네트워크를 지목했습니다.

segments.src: According to Treasury's public statements, the individuals and entities named span several continents and industries, reflecting how sanctioned trade networks have adapted over the years by routing transactions through intermediaries, shell companies, and alternative payment channels.
segments.tr: 재무부의 공식 성명에 따르면, 지목된 개인과 단체들은 여러 대륙과 산업에 걸쳐 있으며, 이는 제재 대상 무역 네트워크가 중개인, 페이퍼컴퍼니, 대체 결제 채널을 통해 거래를 우회하는 방식으로 수년에 걸쳐 어떻게 적응해왔는지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Officials say the latest designations are meant to disrupt those workarounds rather than target a single sector in isolation.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 이번 제재가 단일 부문을 고립시켜 겨냥하기보다는 그러한 우회로를 차단하기 위한 것이라고 말합니다.

segments.tr: ## 금융 조치와 병행되는 외교적 압박

segments.src: Beyond the formal sanctions list, reports indicate that President Trump has been personally engaging with foreign leaders to encourage them to wind down remaining commercial ties with Iran.

segments.src: This kind of direct diplomatic outreach, layered on top of Treasury's designations, suggests the administration is trying to combine legal and political pressure to limit Tehran's remaining trade options, particularly with countries that have historically maintained business relationships with Iranian firms.

segments.src: Analysts caution that the effectiveness of such campaigns depends heavily on cooperation from third-party governments and financial institutions.

segments.src: Sanctions can name specific companies, but enforcement ultimately relies on banks, shipping registries, and trading partners choosing to comply rather than continue doing business through less-scrutinized channels.
segments.tr: 제재는 특정 기업을 지정할 수 있지만, 집행은 궁극적으로 은행, 선박 등록소, 그리고 덜 엄격하게 심사되는 채널을 통해 계속 사업을 영위하기보다는 준수하기로 선택하는 거래 상대방에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Le département du Trésor des États-Unis

segments.src: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent framed the action as part of a coordinated effort to close remaining gaps in the sanctions regime, specifically pointing to networks involved in digital-asset transfers, gold trading, shipping logistics, and aviation support.
segments.tr: Le secrétaire au Trésor, Scott Bessent, a présenté cette mesure comme faisant partie d'un effort coordonné visant à combler les lacunes restantes du régime de sanctions, en pointant spécifiquement les réseaux impliqués dans les transferts d'actifs numériques, le commerce de l'or, la logistique maritime et le soutien à l'aviation.

segments.src: According to Treasury's public statements, the individuals and entities named span several continents and industries, reflecting how sanctioned trade networks have adapted over the years by routing transactions through intermediaries, shell companies, and alternative payment channels.
segments.tr: Selon les déclarations publiques du Trésor, les individus et entités nommés couvrent plusieurs continents et secteurs, reflétant la manière dont les réseaux commerciaux sanctionnés se sont adaptés au fil des ans en acheminant les transactions par l'intermédiaire d'intermédiaires, de sociétés écrans et de canaux de paiement alternatifs.

segments.src: Officials say the latest designations are meant to disrupt those workarounds rather than target a single sector in isolation.
segments.tr: Les responsables affirment que les dernières désignations visent à perturber ces solutions de contournement plutôt qu'à cibler un seul secteur de manière isolée.

segments.tr: a le plus de portée.

segments.src: Shipping and aviation networks round out the package, an area where previous rounds of sanctions have also focused heavily.
segments.tr: Les réseaux maritimes et aériens complètent le paquet, un domaine sur lequel les précédentes séries de sanctions s'étaient également fortement concentrées.

segments.src: Vessels and front companies accused of facilitating oil exports or supplying parts to sanctioned airlines have repeatedly been named in past Treasury actions, and this latest batch appears to continue that pattern rather than introduce an entirely new enforcement approach.
segments.tr: Des navires et des sociétés écrans accusés de faciliter les exportations de pétrole ou de fournir des pièces à des compagnies aériennes sanctionnées ont été nommés à plusieurs reprises dans les actions passées du Trésor, et ce dernier lot semble poursuivre cette tendance plutôt que d'introduire une approche d'application entièrement nouvelle.

segments.src: ## Diplomatic Pressure Alongside Financial Measures

segments.src: This kind of direct diplomatic outreach, layered on top of Treasury's designations, suggests the administration is trying to combine legal and political pressure to limit Tehran's remaining trade options, particularly with countries that have historically maintained business relationships with Iranian firms.
segments.tr: Ce type de démarche diplomatique directe, ajoutée aux désignations du Trésor, suggère que l'administration tente de combiner pression juridique et politique pour limiter les options commerciales restantes de Téhéran, en particulier avec les pays qui ont historiquement entretenu des relations commerciales avec des entreprises iraniennes.

segments.src: Analysts caution that the effectiveness of such campaigns depends heavily on cooperation from third-party governments and financial institutions.
segments.tr: Les analystes préviennent que l'efficacité de telles campagnes dépend fortement de la coopération des gouvernements tiers et des institutions financières.

segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ, điều này có thể lan rộng ra bên ngoài khi các ngân hàng toàn cầu động thái tránh tiếp xúc với các bên bị trừng phạt.

segments.src: Whether this latest push meaningfully changes Iran's ability to trade will depend on how quickly new intermediaries emerge to replace the ones just sanctioned — a pattern that has played out repeatedly in past enforcement rounds.
segments.tr: Liệu nỗ lực mới nhất này có thay đổi đáng kể khả năng thương mại của Iran hay không sẽ phụ thuộc vào tốc độ xuất hiện của các trung gian mới để thay thế những trung gian vừa bị trừng phạt — một mô hình đã lặp đi lặp lại trong các vòng thực thi trước đây.

segments.src: Treasury officials have signaled that additional designations could follow as investigators continue tracing how sanctioned trade is financed and routed.
segments.tr: Các quan chức Bộ Tài chính đã phát đi tín hiệu rằng các chỉ định bổ sung có thể diễn ra tiếp theo khi các điều tra viên tiếp tục truy vết cách thức thương mại bị trừng phạt được tài trợ và định tuyến.

segments.src: The administration has not indicated a specific timeline for further action, but the scale of this week's announcement suggests Iran-related sanctions enforcement remains a priority area heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Chính quyền chưa đưa ra mốc thời gian cụ thể cho các hành động tiếp theo, nhưng quy mô thông báo của tuần này cho thấy việc thực thi các lệnh trừng phạt liên quan đến Iran vẫn là một lĩnh vực ưu tiên khi bước vào mùa thu.
